en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 19. Abi (rah) from Sa’d b. Abdillah from Muhammad b. Isa al-Yaqteeni from ’Amru b. Ibrahim from Khalaf b. Hamad from the one who mentioned it from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
The Almighty Allah keeps seventy calamities away from one who gives Sadaqah in the month of Ramadan.”
